title: Pivotality of a dictator
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $i,j$ be coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The dictator that returns the value of coordinate $i$ is pivotal at $x$ in coordinate $j$ if and only if $j=i$.
